From deep within limestone tunnels to vast interwoven coral caverns, the daellash worms its way through tight confi nes and hidden 
pathways, snapping up a multitude of crustaceans and fi sh that crowd those submerged waterways. Extending long fi lament gills, 
the daellash can weave them through the cramped spaces, allowing the large eel to breathe, all the while pushing deeper into the 
stony depths for new crevices to explore.Unlike its younger form, the adult exchanges group ambush strategies for a long ranged 
solitary hunting, ever vigilant for new nooks and crannies to corner prey. Th ese wildly successful large eels are found especially within 
Dawnsreach, its long powerful body so perfectly adapted to the twisted weaving coral that many believe the species originated there 
before spreading outwards to dominate the rest of Sol'Kesh's coastline.

Encountering A hunter that excels within tight confi nes, the 
daellash is not often witnessed by those outside the narrow and 
claustrophobic tunnels that make up its hunting grounds. A 
mother daellash will use these same tight confi nes to sequester 
her eggs, deep in the tight crevasses and twists of coral strands 
so they can hatch safely.

Saturated Gill Branches Th e daellash can breathe only underwater, 
and can survive without oxygen for 30 minutes.
Serpentine Form Th e daellash has Advantage on Saving Th rows 
made to escape a Grapple.
Wary Instinct (1/Day) When the daellash is currently swallowing a 
creature it soon looks for an escape.

Th e daellash takes the Disengage action and flees. Attempting to 
swim into any deep tunnel it can fi nd away from combat. 
Grasping Bite Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 
Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 10, 
target Medium or smaller creature successfully hit. Failure: 
Target creature has the Grappled condition (Escape DC 12). 
Until this Grapple ends, at the start of the daellash’s turn while 
it is Grappling the creature, it automatically deals 7 (1d8 + 3) 
Piercing damage as its jaws sink into the target.
Gulping Maw Th e daellash makes one Grasping Bite attack 
against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the 
attack hits, the target creature is swallowed, and the Grapple 
condition ends. Th e swallowed target is Blinded and Restrained, 
it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the 
daellash, and it takes 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage at the start 
of each of the daellash’s turns. Th e daellash can only have one 
target swallowed at a time. If the daellash dies, a swallowed 
creature is no longer Restrained by it and can escape from the 
corpse using 5 ft. of movement exiting Prone. 
A wide maw, lined with a rigid 
beak-like lip, the daellash can 
swallow many of Sol’Kesh’s
